description: Informal, conversational Chinese or English prose for blogs, essays, and newsletters. Remove templated phrasing, vary the rhythm, and keep one human voice from the first sentence to the last.

rules.instruction: Ban templated openings ("in today's rapidly developing era"; "with the growing popularity of …") and templated endings ("in conclusion … let us look forward together").
Average paragraph length is at most five sentences; three consecutive equal-length paragraphs is a defect (monotone rhythm).
Delete three-part summaries that carry no information.
One "speaker" throughout; no mid-piece switch from chatting to preaching.
The opening sentence puts the reader inside a concrete scene or problem; no background survey openers.
Every sentence survives being read aloud without stumbling (the read-aloud test).
